a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve hits 8 needs two full rounds first, so we would both very likely be caught short. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you'd rather contest it, a simultaneous take gets split at random. If I end up with extra, I'll give it back to the reserve.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I'm sorry this breaks the agreement. From now on I'll operate every round so you can build the reserve back up. I won't take any more cells.
